industry: Residential / DTC saunas (infrared and traditional units, outdoor barrel/cabin saunas, related accessories and warranties)
words_and_claims_to_avoid: Disease cure/treat/prevent claims (cancer, heart disease, COVID, diabetes, etc.) without competent and reliable scientific evidence — FTC has warned sauna marketers
'Detoxifies heavy metals' / miracle detox claims without substantiation
Weight-loss guarantees or 'melt pounds' promises without evidence
Infrared vs traditional performance claims that are inaccurate to the product
'Doctor recommended' / medical device implications if not true/authorized
'America's most beloved' / #1 ranking without a real substantiated basis
Fake scarcity on mystery codes; demo codes presented as unique personal offers
Electrical/install 'licensed' claims if the seller does not provide licensed install
Financing 'as low as $X/mo' without Reg Z triggering-term disclosures when required
compliance_notes: FTC Act + Health Products Compliance Guidance: health benefit claims need competent and reliable scientific evidence (often RCTs for disease claims). Do not advertise saunas as treating/preventing/curing disease without that evidence.
FTC COVID-era warning letters went to infrared sauna marketers for unsupported virus/immune disease claims — treat disease claims as high risk.
Keep copy experiential (relaxation, routine, comfort) unless the client holds substantiation for a specific health claim.
Infrared vs traditional: only claim differences that are true for the SKU (heat type, temperature range, cabinetry) — no invented clinical superiority.
16 CFR 233/251: %/$ off, mystery offers, free gifts need clear conditions and bona fide prices.
If quoting monthly payments or APR: Regulation Z / 12 CFR 1026.24 triggering-term disclosures (down payment, repayment terms, APR).
Installation: if advertising delivery/install, state what is included and only claim licensed electrical work if true in the jurisdiction.
39 USC 3001: no official health-agency look-alike mailers.
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: calm, aspiration, unfinished-intent curiosity are fine when legal.
Only laws/compliance are hard limits — especially FTC health-claim substantiation.
Every angle and emotion_by_offer combo carries sell_the_outcome_line.
Vendor ROI labeled agency-only unverified; never print as fact on a client card.
Prefer one product hero + one offer + one QR (roofing-round5 directional).
Leave thin: do not invent studies or extra gold patterns.
